title: Mimas rules
description: Match-wide rules (rules.json): the damage lanes, the stats and abilities every hero has before gear, and the modifiers that apply to every attack.

damageTypes.description: The damage lanes. Changing this list means updating the enums in item.schema.json and ability.schema.json too.

globalModifiers.description: Modifier ids evaluated for every attack (high ground is the shipped example).

heights.description: Converts a map's integer height levels into the body units sight and trajectories are measured in (design: #board, #line-of-sight).

unitsPerLevel.description: Height units one map level is worth.

body.description: A hero's body height in units above the tile top; this is what blocks a shot.

aim.description: Where attacks leave from and land, in units above the tile top. 1..body.

baseStats.description: The numbers every hero starts with before gear. hp and ap are required; no value may be negative.

innateAbilities.description: Ability ids every hero has whatever it wears. At least one must be a movement ability; no item may grant one of these.
